messages:
anya: planning cross-service deploy tonight 22:30 UTC. services: api:v2026-05-10.1, runtime:2.4.0, router:1.0.0, console:1.13.0. want quick sign-off on pins and rollback plan.

liam: request: pin runtime:2.4.0 for hosted only; dedicated stays at 2.3.1 until we validate kv behavior. fallback runtime:2.3.1.

teja: console has UI tweak only. router major bump but with compatibility shim. sequence: api -> router -> runtime -> console (router early to limit header mismatch).

anya: proposed canary: 3% x10m, 20% x12m, then 100%. stagger 30s between service steps.

ops-bot: preflight checks ok: infra capacity verified, DB migrations none, feature flags ready.

liam: rollback criteria: abort if API 5xx >0.7% for 5m, or p50 latency +100ms over baseline for 10m, or runtime uncaught exceptions >8/min. Also manual abort via /deploy abort <id>.

teja: add console smoke: grep for `render_error` and spot check new CSS on canary sessions. router: watch header propagation mismatch metric.

anya: locking pins: runtime pinned hosted:2.4.0 fallback:2.3.1; dedicated:2.3.1; router:1.0.0; console:1.13.0; api tag:v2026-05-10.1.

deploy-bot: scheduled: run-id 20260510-07 by anya at 2026-05-10T22:30:00Z. Canary plan set. Auto-rollback thresholds applied per thread.

anya: I'll trigger in ~15m. flag if you want a hold.

liam: ready. will watch kv miss and tokenization diffs.

teja: monitoring hooks set for router header and console render logs. quick abort snippet for runbook:
```
/deploy abort 20260510-07 --reason "auto-threshold"
/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.3.1
```

deploy-bot: run 20260510-07: canary started for api and router. 3% traffic routed to new variants. Monitoring active.

anya: thanks — keep updates short here. will write release notes after completion.
